sense: of a storm, a fire, a war: arise suddenly

terms.gloss: come forth, arise, break out: of storms, fires, wars, an uproar
evidence: Liv. 26.27.5: ignēs plūribus simul locīs (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: subitō coorta tempestās cum magnō fragōre tonitribusque tam dēnsō rēgem operuit nimbō ut cōnspectum ejus contiōnī abstulerit
phrases.english: a storm that suddenly arose, with a great crash and peals of thunder, covered the king in so thick a cloud that it hid him from the sight of the assembly
